description: From the Pradera de San Marcos you look across the river confluence at the Alcázar riding its rocky crag, the fairytale pile of slate spires and pointed turrets washed in warm floodlight against the cloudy night sky. The battlemented walls run down the cliff edge on either side, and below the dark treetops of the valley hide the meeting of the Eresma and Clamores rivers. Behind the castle a few lights glimmer along the old-town ridge.

prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic artistic interpretation of the Alcazar of Segovia, Spain, at night, viewed from the Mirador de la Pradera de San Marcos across the confluence of the rivers. The fairytale castle with its slate spires and pointed turrets rises on the rocky crag, floodlit warm gold against a cloudy dark night sky; the battlemented walls run along the cliff edge. Dark treetops and the river valley below, a few distant city lights. No identifiable people prominent. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere in the image, no on-image text at all.
